description: Wait or pause execution for a specified duration in seconds before proceeding to the next task.
command: python3 -c 'import sys, time, json, re; raw="${answer1}"; match=re.search(r"\d+", raw); secs=int(match.group()) if match else 10; print(f"⏳ Waiting for {secs} seconds..."); time.sleep(secs); print(json.dumps({"status": "completed", "waited_seconds": secs}))'
questions: How many seconds or duration should the timer wait? (e.g. 5, 10, 30, 60)*
